name: @fitpath/widget
description: The embeddable fit check: one script tag on a product page, a button by the buy control, and a modal that answers from the precomputed maneuver library.

scripts.build: npm run precompute && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode loader && vite build --mode modal && node scripts/report-sizes.ts
scripts.build:only: vite build --mode loader && vite build --mode modal && node scripts/report-sizes.ts
